mechanism: Prednisone increases nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk of tobramycin by enhancing aminoglycoside accumulation in renal tubules and inner ear; concurrent use impairs renal function and fluid balance.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and tobramycin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antimicrobial if possible; assess audiometric function if prolonged concurrent use.
